NUTRITION
  GUIDELINES:
    - "Protein target 1.2..1.6 g/kg/day; prioritize 20-35 g high-quality protein per meal."
    - "Calcium 1000..1200 mg/day from diet; include dairy, fortified plant milk, or canned fish with bones."
    - "Vitamin D 800..1000 IU/day (or per GP recommendation) to support calcium absorption."
    - "Aim for 25..30 g fibre/day from vegetables, fruit, whole grains, legumes."
    - "Prioritise low to moderate glycaemic-load carbohydrates around training; avoid fasted high-intensity in heat."
    - "Include omega-3 sources 2..3 servings/week (fatty fish or flax/chia) for inflammation support."
    - "Ensure 2..3 servings/day of calcium-rich foods and include one high-alkaline vegetable serving daily (greens)."
    - "Limit alcohol; if consumed, keep to <=1 standard drink/day and avoid close to training/sleep."
    - "Distribute calcium across meals (don't take >500..600 mg calcium at once for absorption efficiency)."
    - "Hydration: start sessions well-hydrated; include cool fluids before/during exercise to reduce vasomotor triggers."
    - "Cooling strategies pre/during/post: cool shower before training, cold drink during, cooling towel/vest available post-session."
    - "Maintain regular meal timing given cycle variability; avoid long fasting periods that may worsen symptoms."
  MICRONUTRIENT_ACTIONS:
    - "If dietary intake limited, consider supplement: Vitamin D3 daily and Calcium to meet targets after consulting GP."
    - "Check with GP before starting any new supplements, especially if on medications."
  SAMPLE_DAY:
    DAY "Sample day - training day":
      meals:
        - "Breakfast: Greek yogurt or fortified plant yoghurt with berries, 20..30 g protein (egg or protein source), 1 serving calcium-rich."
        - "Pre-workout (60..90 min): small snack - banana or oat porridge with nut butter; cool water 300..500 ml."
        - "Post-workout (within 60 min): lean protein 25..35 g (chicken, fish, tofu) + mixed veg + whole grain (rice/quinoa)."
        - "Snack: cottage cheese or hummus with vegetable sticks; 10..15 g protein."
        - "Dinner: fatty fish or legume-based meal, leafy greens, starchy veg; ensure 300..500 mg calcium across day."
        - "Evening: small calcium-containing snack if daily intake low (milk or fortified alternative)."
  TIMING_AND_COOLING:
    - "Prefer training in cooler parts of day (morning or evening); avoid hottest times."
    - "Consume cool fluids pre/during training; avoid very hot beverages around sessions."
    - "Avoid fasted high-intensity cardio in heat; if doing conditioning, ensure carbohydrate availability and cooling."
    - "For 1RM testing: schedule in coolest part of day, ensure well-hydrated, eat a balanced meal 2-3 hours prior or small carbohydrate/protein snack 60-90 min prior, use thorough warm-up and progressive build to singles, allow extended rests and cooling between attempts."
  MONITORING:
    - "Track body weight, training performance, sleep, hot flash frequency/severity, and dietary calcium/protein intake weekly."
    - "Review Vitamin D status via GP if concerns about bone health or low sun exposure."
  SAFETY:
    - "Do not use sauna or hot baths post-session; use cool/cold showers and cooling garments instead."
    - "Avoid fasted HIIT in heat; fasted HIIT only allowed in cool conditions (early morning) with cooling strategies and stop if symptomatic."
    - "Hot yoga and other heated activities are not recommended due to heat intolerance; substitute with regular yoga-like mobility outside heat or swimming/cycling-based flexibility work."
    - "1RM testing only in a cool environment with spotters/personal supervision; stop if excessive dizziness, palpitations, or vasomotor distress occur."
    - "Consult GP before starting supplements or if bleeding irregularities or other concerning symptoms arise."
